reason: Thermon makes industrial heat tracing, process heaters and boilers. SPX overlaps only in its HVAC segment, which includes electric heaters and boilers. SPX's mix is mainly cooling towers, air movement and commercial HVAC, and it also has a separate Detection & Measurement business (locators, fare collection, navigation lighting, RF) that Thermon has no match for. SPX sells largely to building owners, contractors and utilities, with some industrial customers. Thermon sells to industrial end users and EPC contractors. The overlap is partial on both product and customers, and not strong enough on both for a direct-peer score.
